strengths: Backlinks, block references, and a graph view over linked notes
Mature product with continuous development since 2020
weaknesses: Cloud-hosted by default; self-hosting still ships the same note cap as the free hosted tier unless an operator edits the database directly
No AI or agent integration of any kind
Canonical data lives in a hosted Postgres schema rather than portable plain files
why_it_matters: Shows a mature, actively maintained linked-notes second brain built around a hosted-first cloud-database architecture rather than local files, with no AI layer at all.
